caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is called Major countries in worldwide graphite mine production from 2015 to 2019 (in 1,000 metric tons). The x-axis plots Country while the y-axis measures 2018.
caption_L2L3: By far, China produced the most graphite in 2018. Brazil is in second place but they produced around 600,000 metric tons less of graphite than China did. All other countries each produced less than 100,000 metric tons of graphite.
